title: 50 Céntimos

obverse.description:
Costa Rica coat of arms. Seven stars represent the seven provinces, three extinct volcanoes for the three mountain ranges, two ships symbolizing the country's geographical situation between atlantic and pacific ocean and sunrise on the left

NOTE: size and space between letters varies in mintages. outer rim of Coat of Arms slightly different. versions with normal and small ship
obverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DE COSTA RICA 
AMERICA CENTRAL
REPUBLICA DE COSTA RICA
1982
obverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Costa Rica
Central America
Republic of Costa Rica

reverse.description:
Value within a laurel wreath and initials of the "Banco Central de Costa Rica"

NOTE: versions with thick-leafed and thin-
leafed wreath in mintages, size of letters varies also
reverse.unabridged_legend:
America Central
50
Centimos
Banco Central de Costa Rica
reverse.lettering_translation:
Central America
50
Centimos
Central Bank of Costa Rica

comments:
Although these coins have been demonetized, they are still redeemable at the Central Bank of Costa Rica.

 

KM#209.1: Large ships, letters incuse

KM#209.2: Small ships, thin wreath, letters in relief
